tone.neutral: plain message with no semantic color
tone.info: context worth noting, not a problem
tone.warning: a condition needs attention before it becomes a problem

presentation.banner: full-width block at the top of a region
presentation.inline: lightweight message inline with surrounding content

rules.onDismiss: Omit onDismiss to render a non-dismissible alert; the dismiss control only appears when it is provided.
rules.title: Use title for a short heading and put the full message in children.

Alert.banner: <Alert title="Actualización disponible" tone="info">Hay una nueva versión lista para instalar.</Alert>
Alert.dismissible: <Alert onDismiss={dismiss} tone="warning">La sesión expira en 5 minutos.</Alert>
Alert.danger: <Alert presentation="inline" tone="danger">No se pudo guardar el cambio.</Alert>
